artworks.title: Jason with the Golden Fleece
artworks.description: Thorvaldsen's neoclassical Jason after the Colchian ordeal — fleece on his arm, spear in hand, the Argonautica frozen at the prize won.

artworks.title: Jason and the Dragon (Douris cup)
artworks.description: Attic red-figure kylix: the dragon of the fleece swallows and disgorges Jason while Athena watches — one of antiquity's strangest images of the quest.

artworks.title: Jason and Medea
artworks.description: Waterhouse stages the Colchian pact that makes the Argonautica possible: Medea mixes the charm while Jason waits to face Aeëtes' bulls.

artworks.title: Jason and Medea
artworks.description: Moreau's Salon canvas after the fleece is taken — Jason triumphant, Medea at his side, the voyage's eastern prize already shadowed by later betrayal.

artworks.title: Meeting of Jason and King Aeëtes
artworks.description: Study for Carracci's Palazzo Fava Argonaut frieze: Jason before Aeëtes, the Colchian king who will price the Golden Fleece in fire-breathing bulls.

films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Harryhausen's skeleton army made the Argonautica modern cinema's favourite voyage — the fleece quest as stop-motion spectacle.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.description: Apollonius' epic remains the blueprint of the crew-quest — Argo, the Clashing Rocks, and the fleece at the world's edge.
